title: Durabilidad de evidencia, bloqueo y resultados de guardado

changes.detail: Se agregó labRevision como token de escritura versionado para detectar otra pestaña o restauración concurrente sin comparar estados normalizados grandes. Las escrituras directas renuevan el token; persist recibe y verifica la revisión previa esperada en los commits del tablero, y las restauraciones nuevas renuevan la suya. Los reintentos con resultado incierto se rechazan cuando el token durable avanzó.

La escritura previa se confirma por comparación del estado candidato exacto; si el navegador no permite la lectura posterior, el resultado permanece unknown y se preservan los bytes para no eliminar evidencia potencialmente vinculada. Los errores de preparación se distinguen de permisos o cambios de identidad.

La generación de labRevision quedó dentro del bloque de preparación controlada. La prueba integrada desactiva otros perfiles para omitir la ruta de notificaciones e inyecta el error en el tercer UUID, que corresponde a labRevision; confirma rechazo seguro más compensación del blob temporal antes de guardar estado.

La restauración y el alta de evidencia comparten un Web Lock. La restauración lee el estado previo antes de escribir blobs, conserva bytes recuperables huérfanos, reconcilia el índice de cuota y revierte el estado ante fallo seguro.

warnings: laboratoryEvidence is both dynamically and statically imported.

standardBuildCommand.reason: pnpm blocked esbuild@0.18.20, esbuild@0.25.12 and esbuild@0.28.2 build scripts as ignored; equivalent tsc, Vite client and Worker steps were run directly and passed. No approval policy was changed.

coverage: Web Lock rejection leaves form retryable without state or blobs.
Upload and v2 restore wait for another tab's lock; state changed in another tab during the wait rejects the upload.
Failed compensation retains recoverable bytes and reconciles quota index; retry commits once.
Native IndexedDB transaction abort in Edge preserves prior metadata/blob counts and leaves submission retryable; physical quota exhaustion was not induced.
Unreadable restore preflight stages no blobs; scope conflict and quota failure preserve prior state.
Uncertain write-then-throw preserves exact metadata and blobs; a retry is rejected as stale.
Restored evidence remains available through company and monthly closure; mobile dialog fits.
browserEdge.caveat: The Edge runner changes state while upload is waiting for Web Lock, not during the subsequent store await; the final commit guard is covered by source inspection and focused component tests.

independentReview.scope: Review labRevision/stale-tab semantics, upload/restore lock, uncertain write and readback, IndexedDB index recovery, and compatibility with prior lab contracts.
findings: The initial UUID fault injection hit notification generation before labRevision. The fixture now disables other profiles so the third UUID specifically exercises labRevision; 23/23 focused tests pass after the correction.
The durable token does not detect arbitrary localStorage tampering that deliberately preserves the token; this remains outside the stated cross-tab revision contract.

limits: This is stage 2A implementation evidence, not acceptance of all stage 2 or the product.
A native IndexedDB transaction abort was induced in Edge; physical browser quota exhaustion was not induced through real disk pressure.
Other stage 2 adversarial cases, screen-reader acceptance and benchmark remain open.
No commit, PR, Site update, account connection, operational API call or external deployment occurred. The Site remains private.
